reviewer2761431
Manager Rpa at a retailer with 10,001+ employees
We've used Agent Builder, IXP, and Maestro for orchestration. We have created context-grounded searches or chatbots using context grounding, and we also use context grounding within an Agentic flow where a bot or agent reads ServiceNow tickets to determine whether it has been assigned to the right work group. If it has not been assigned correctly due to human error, it automatically reassigns it to the right group. I would assess Agentic AI's ability to extract data points as effective. We created an agent for the purpose of extracting data, though not in a document. We created what we call an email conversation agent that engages with a customer, vendor, or someone in an email conversation with a set goal of extracting specific data points for an action to be performed subsequently. The one automation we have deployed in production involves the agent interacting with team members to collect data points and create a ServiceNow ticket. We appreciate almost all features of UiPath Platform, with one of the most successful ones being the use of Coms Mining. Most of the new features related to AI have all been good, and we use Agentic. We have already created a few agents and have started to use Maestro for a few flows, though we are not yet there to orchestrate an end-to-end workflow. We have good ROI from the automations we have developed with UiPath Platform, which far exceeds the investment in the platform. It has saved us tens of thousands of hours in manual effort, making the team members happy to pursue other things of value.

Since we're still on-prem, the Orchestrator feature of UiPath Platform has been key in us being able to monitor and see exactly what is going on with the automations. We also find it really valuable that we can automate not just Microsoft, but also PeopleSoft and other applications. Since using UiPath Platform, we're now able to process between 15 to 18 million dollars a month in invoices that are coming through automatically through the automation. It's not relieving us of FTEs, however, it means that these people aren't having to spend the time to do it, so they're able to focus their work on other beneficial items and it's less prone to error. My team all has to go through UiPath Academy, as we have a citizen development program, and everyone who goes through the citizen development program has to go through UiPath Academy before I give them their licenses. The biggest benefit we've seen from using UiPath Academy is the fact that the lessons are still out there, so if you need to revisit something or if you're unsure of how to do something, the forum can help, Copilot can help, but it's better to go back to what UiPath said in the training. We are part of the UiPath Community. In terms of the value that we've gained by being part of the UiPath user community, we really enjoy being able to access what's going on in the forum, and having the opportunity to attend some of the local UiPath events. Pittsburgh doesn't have as much going on with their team or group, but the opportunity has been there in the past. It's beneficial to see what other people are doing at those events because it's very easy to think you're in a silo, especially within healthcare, so it's nice to see what others are doing.

I would evaluate customer service and technical support as lacking; we're on the Bronze tier support plan, which is honestly miserable. They then emailed again with another step that didn't help, forgot my ticket, and didn't communicate for days. I had to contact our sales agent to get a person on the phone to help me, and the issue was resolved in 30 minutes to an hour, demonstrating that they took a support ticket that could be settled quickly and stretched it over 10 days. It was not great.

Valuable Features
UiPath Platform is celebrated for its intuitive interface, offering rapid automation through low-code/no-code solutions. The platform excels with Studio's drag-and-drop workflow building, and Orchestrator's efficient bot management. Seamless integration capabilities and robust AI enhancements, including Document Understanding, reduce manual errors and streamline processes. The supportive community and comprehensive training through UiPath Academy enhance user adoption. Features like process mining, API integration, and customizable components boost flexibility and reduce infrastructure costs, maximizing efficiency and scalability across diverse applications.
"One of the best features UiPath Platform offers is that it is user-friendly, with end-to-end automation capabilities, ease of use, strong AI integration, and a low-code approach so that even a beginner or business user can start developing automations seamlessly."
"UiPath Platform has brought us a lot of projects and is helping us in our day-to-day life."
"UiPath Platform has positively impacted my organization as I am completely into UiPath Platform with almost 50 plus automations running, saving many hours and helping business users automate many processes, saving time for them and working 24/7, even during holidays."
Room for Improvement
Users suggest improvements to UiPath Platform's licensing model and integration capabilities. They recommend enhancing AI and machine learning features and more compatibility with Microsoft products. Some find the platform's security and governance areas lacking and express concerns over its scalability and ease of use. Many remark the need for better debugging abilities, documentation and technical support. Pricing structures and adaptability for small businesses are also cited as areas needing attention, along with providing clearer guidance on maximizing features and updates.
"UiPath Platform is already quite comprehensive, but if I have to name a few areas that it can be improved, the first thing I would say is licensing. Licensing and pricing could be less complex, more affordable and more transparent, especially for the organizations who are just starting up or trying to scale."
"UiPath Platform can be improved by better handling of updates; whenever there is something new, they keep forcing customers to upgrade."
"I am overall very satisfied with UiPath Platform but believe there are areas for improvement, such as the licensing model being potentially expensive for smaller organizations and startups, as well as the desire for more built-in AI templates and reusable components for faster intelligent automations."
ROI
Users have experienced a substantial return from UiPath Platform, with many citing significant time savings and reduced errors. Some reported a decrease in human error by 60-75% and processing time by about 50-90%. Automation led to freeing up employee resources, enabling focus on more complex tasks, while also ensuring high data accuracy. In financial terms, savings have been evident with organizations saving substantial manpower costs and reducing operational expenses.
Pricing
Enterprise buyers evaluating UiPath Platform often encounter varied insights on pricing, setup, and licensing. Many users highlight its competitive yet premium pricing, noting a structured licensing model that can feel complex. While UiPath offers a free Community Edition, the Enterprise version is considered more expensive than alternatives like Automation Anywhere and Microsoft Power Automate, though it's praised for ROI and comprehensive features. Pricing can be challenging for smaller companies, favoring larger enterprises for scaling and strategic automation adoption.
"It is based on the use case. If the use case needs several bots, it gets expensive."
"The price of UiPath Platform in the Middle East region is a little bit high; having a lower price for the Middle East region would make it more attractive."
"I would definitely recommend UiPath, although the major concern is that it's not super cheap. Despite its higher price, I understand the complexity behind it since it's the most comprehensive RPA solution."
Popular Use Cases
UiPath Platform is primarily used for automating business processes, including tasks like invoice processing, data extraction, repetitive reporting, data entry, and tasks involving various systems such as ERP and CRM. Leveraged across finance, HR, and IT sectors, it enhances productivity by eliminating repetitive tasks and allows 24/7 bot deployment for uninterrupted process execution. Users integrate it with AI features to streamline operations and reduce manual errors, maximizing efficiency and ROI.
Service and Support
Customers generally find UiPath Platform's service and support responsive and helpful. Many value the swift response times and knowledgeable teams, especially those with dedicated technical account managers. However, some encounter delay issues, particularly with complex cases or when using lower-tier support plans. The community forum is a widely used resource, praised for quick resolutions and community-driven insights. While experiences vary, many appreciate the access to well-organized tutorials and training resources.
Deployment
Users generally found UiPath Platform's initial setup to be straightforward, with some variations based on technical familiarity and infrastructure complexity. While many praised its ease and user-friendly nature, others highlighted a learning curve, particularly when integrating with other systems. Initial deployments often required minimal technical support, but larger or more complex implementations sometimes faced challenges related to security, infrastructure, or internal processes. Despite these, most found the process manageable, aided by UiPath's robust documentation and support resources.
Scalability
UiPath Platform is widely considered highly scalable, adapting to diverse organizational needs. Users highlight its ease of scaling, especially with cloud integration, allowing seamless expansion of capabilities. The platform supports adding more bots and virtual machines without complications, making it suitable for enterprises of various sizes. User experiences reflect satisfaction with the platform's ability to manage growing demands efficiently, although licensing and resource management can occasionally present challenges in larger deployments.
Stability
UiPath Platform is praised for stability, with frequent positive experiences of smooth operation and minimal downtime. Many highlight reliable performance, even across varied environments like cloud or enterprise settings. It's noted for handling errors efficiently and adapting well to changes, although occasional updates introduce temporary issues. Some users mention external factors, like third-party applications or infrastructure, as sources of challenges rather than inherent platform flaws. Overall, its stability receives consistently favorable remarks.
These insights are based on the in-depth reviews provided by peers to help you make a better buying decision.

UiPath Platform delivers a robust set of features that enhance automation and productivity. With components like Orchestrator, task management is optimized, facilitating better scalability. Users benefit from advanced AI and document understanding tools, boosting data handling accuracy and reducing errors. Despite its strengths, UiPath faces challenges with upgrading processes, AI enhancements, and user documentation. Integration and selector sensitivity issues, along with support and licensing complexities, highlight areas for potential improvement. Users request smoother deployment, error handling, and migration processes. Enhanced support for RHEL/Ubuntu, LINQ, and Lambda and improved real-time insights, automation recording, and scheduling are desired. Streamlining the experience for non-technical users with simplified workflows remains a priority.
What are the key features of UiPath Platform?
Drag-and-Drop Functionality: Allows users to design workflows easily without extensive technical skills.
Orchestrator: Enhances task management and enables scalable automation.
AI and Document Understanding: Improves data accuracy and minimizes errors.
System Integration: Offers seamless integration with SAP, CRM, Oracle, and more.
Active Community and Training: UiPath Academy provides resources for skill development.
What benefits should users look for in reviews?
Increased Efficiency: Reduction in manual workloads through automation of repetitive tasks.
Improved Accuracy: Enhanced data handling capabilities reduce errors.
Productivity Boost: Supports both attended and unattended automations to streamline operations.
Scalability: Ability to handle growing automation demands efficiently.
Integration Benefits: Easy integration with enterprise systems for streamlined operations.
UiPath Platform is widely implemented across sectors such as finance, healthcare, insurance, HR, IT, and supply chain to automate repetitive business tasks. Common uses include automating data entry, invoice processing, document management, report generation, and customer service operations. Organizations value the platform's ability to integrate seamlessly with systems like SAP, CRM, and Oracle, allowing for enhanced efficiency and accuracy in processing both structured and unstructured data.
UiPath Platform was previously known as UiPath Maestro, UiPath Apps, UiPath Agent Builder.

"UiPath Platform is already quite comprehensive, but if I have to name a few areas that it can be improved, the first thing I would say is licensing. Licensing and pricing could be less complex, more affordable and more transparent, especially for the organizations who are just starting up or trying to scale."
What is our primary use case?
My main use case for UiPath Platform is automations to develop bots for deterministic tasks.
An example of a deterministic task I automate with UiPath Platform is a report that we have to create, which is about developing a dashboard for customer satisfaction. At the end of every support call, a survey is sent to the customer, and when they respond, it comes to a survey platform. We run a report and curate it to different teams at HP. A human was taking about six hours approximately, and I developed a bot on UiPath Platform, which runs the report in mere eight minutes.
Regarding my main use cases with UiPath Platform, I have had a few other use cases, a few related to report generations itself and few sending completion reports. If you have to send a completion report at the end of the week or every week to a manager, we have automated that as well.
We are mainly looking at agentic automations for processes that involve unstructured information, multiple systems, or which require some level of decision making rather than just straightforward rule-based tasks. One example would be document processing or email processing. As an AI agent, an agent can understand the intent of incoming email, it can identify the relevant information from attachments or documents, it can classify the request and determine what action needs to happen next. UiPath robots can handle the repeated execution. Another area is exceptional handling. In traditional RPA, an unexpected scenario causes the workflow to stop. Somebody has to investigate what happened and then fix it. With agentic automation, an agent can analyze the exception and look for the available information and determine whether it matches a scenario or not.
We are also looking at data validation and reconciliation. When information comes from multiple sources, an agent can compare the information, identify the discrepancies and explain what appears to be wrong. Another use case can also be knowledge-intensive support processes. Instead of having an employee search through multiple documents to find an answer, the AI agent can provide the relevant information and provide a summary response. This will not just save time, it will also save a tech lead or a team leader's time.
What is most valuable?
One of the best features UiPath Platform offers is that it is user-friendly. That is one of the biggest strengths and its end-to-end automation capabilities, ease of use, and definitely strong AI integration. It is not just about automating repetitive tasks now; you can automate desktop and web applications as well. You can integrate APIs, handle documents, and now the latest capabilities to build AI-powered agents. I would also say that it has a low code approach so that even a beginner can start with UiPath Platform seamlessly.
Not necessarily a developer, but even a business user can develop automations. Those who are native to programming have the flexibility to handle more complex scenarios. This is because of the features that UiPath Platform has.
When it comes to how UiPath Platform has impacted my organization positively, I would definitely say it has reduced manual effort and improved process efficiency. The most stress is on the manual effort. It has helped us automate repetitive rule-based tasks, saves a lot of time. It reduces human errors because it is deterministic. It is black or white, there is no gray area. It always gives better accuracy and better consistency because the same process is executed in the same way every time. A human can make an error, different team members can make different errors, but a bot will not. Another positive impact is that our teams can spend more time on higher value work instead of those mundane repetitive tasks. Overall, it has made an impact on improving productivity and standardized processes.
One of the biggest benefits we have seen is freeing up employee time and reducing human error. Many business processes involve repetitive activities. There is no process that is free of repetitive activities. There will be some process, possibly like entering the data or moving the information between applications or giving an approval or the best use case is generating reports. Many teams spend a lot of time generating reports, which can definitely be automated because it is very deterministic. When these activities are performed manually, there is always a possibility of errors, especially when the workload is high. With UiPath Platform, we can automate these steps and make execution much more consistent. The automation follows predefined rules and performs the same steps every time. This improves efficiency as well as reduces effort. The time savings are definitely significant. Employees do not have to spend a huge part of the day just doing this. Rather, they can focus on exception handling, they can focus on analysis or any other decision-making tasks. From a business perspective, this has helped us improve productivity, turnaround time and process consistency. The impact is not just saving hours, it is about employee well-being as well. It is about using employee capacity more effectively while we have better consistency or better quality.
